statement: Let pop(f), for any byte array f, be the number of indices j with 0 <= j < len(responses) such that f occurs as a space-delimited word in responses[j]; a space-delimited word is a maximal contiguous block of non-space bytes (32 is space), and if f occurs more than once in the same responses[j] it still contributes only 1. The function returns a result r such that: (1) len(r) = len(features); (2) for every j with 0 <= j < len(features) there is exactly one i with 0 <= i < len(r) for which r[i] is byte-for-byte equal to features[j]; and (3) for every i with 0 <= i+1 < len(r), either pop(r[i]) > pop(r[i+1]), or pop(r[i]) = pop(r[i+1]) and the unique index j with r[i] = features[j] is less than the unique index k with r[i+1] = features[k].
preconditions: features is a slice of byte-array strings and responses is a slice of byte-array strings. 1 <= len(features) <= 10^4. For every i with 0 <= i < len(features), 1 <= len(features[i]) <= 10, every byte of features[i] is an ASCII lowercase letter (97..122), and no two entries of features are equal as byte arrays. 1 <= len(responses) <= 10^2. For every j with 0 <= j < len(responses), 1 <= len(responses[j]) <= 10^3, every byte of responses[j] is either an ASCII lowercase letter or a space (32), responses[j] has no leading space, no trailing space, and no two consecutive spaces.
